_comment: Committed baseline for samples/ShadowWorkloads/compare.py (#166). Captured locally on 2026-10-22 with `dotnet run --configuration Release -- --filter '*' --exporters json` (BenchmarkDotNet 0.15.8, Windows 11 (10.0.26200.9711/25H2/2025Update/HudsonValley2), Intel Core i7-14700HX, .NET 10.0.13 (10.0.13, 10.0.1326.50504)). Allocation is the hard gate (more than 50% regression fails); latency is advisory only, because shared GitHub-hosted runner wall-clock is too noisy to fail on. Re-baseline from the first CI run if ubuntu-latest numbers differ materially. Scenario_RegisterSubscribersOneAtATime was added on 2026-10-30 (same machine, same command). shadow.yaml compares against the latest published package run in the same job; this file is the offline fallback (`python3 compare.py <results> docs/shadow-baseline.json`).
